notes: Cloud Master + Offline Queue. Introduces a record-level Supabase warehouse master store instead of whole-dataset phone-vs-cloud snapshots. Each Product, Inventory record, Order, Operation, Carpet Roll, Cutting History item and other managed record now has its own cloud identity, version and tombstone. Devices become cache/offline work stations: online changes are committed record-by-record to Supabase, offline changes enter a persistent mutation queue and replay when connectivity returns, then the device refreshes from cloud. A one-time activation captures local-only/newer records before switching the new Cloud Master to ACTIVE. Legacy whole-dataset Upload / Download / Keep Device / Keep Cloud controls are retired. Real same-record concurrent edits pause only that record and can be resolved with Use Cloud, Apply Device or Delete Duplicate. The legacy user_datasets table is retained unchanged as rollback/audit backup. The Cloud Master seed also preserves the confirmed Barton lifecycle correction and separates Grand Cru Barton 2 from Tolko Ulay Plywood.
